requirements.verifier_assertion: test_outputs.py asserts os.path.exists('/workspace/output.xlsx'); a missing output file records accuracy=0 with error 'output file not exist'.

test_outputs.py sets INPUT='/workspace/data/input.xlsx' and passes it (or the tests/input_ref.xlsx fallback) to compare_workbooks_with_regression; the agent must build from the provided input workbook.
test_outputs.py sets ANSWER_POSITION="'furtherex2'!D55:R123"; classification into regression vs modification cells and scoring are restricted to this sheet+range.
Modification (blank) cells the reference fills are the named furtherex2 line-items; every such cell must match golden within tolerance for reward=1.0.
Regression cells (identical between input and golden) must stay identical in the output; altering non-target cells drops regression below 1.0 and fails.
must_include: Do not alter any other cell

requirements.verifier_assertion: The grader LibreOffice-recomputes the output and compares resulting values against the reference with 1% numeric tolerance; cells may hold formulas or their computed values (open_spreadsheet.py + evaluation.compare_cell_value).
Modification denominator must be fully satisfied: every period column of each named line-item must be filled (any unfilled target cell fails since mod_ratio<1.0).
must_include: Every period column of each named line-item must be filled

requirements.verifier_assertion: acc = 1.0 iff reg_ratio == 1.0 AND mod_ratio == 1.0 (test_accuracy); reward 1.0 requires both regression and modification at 100%.
